room_rent.note: Policyholder can choose 1% of SI per day or no capping. Proportionate deduction applies if room taken above chosen limit.

icu.display: 2x chosen Room Rent or No Cap
icu.note: ICU is 2 times the selected room rent limit; if no-cap room rent chosen, ICU is also no cap. Proportionate deduction not applied to ICU.

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay for insured persons aged 61 years and above at first policy issuance; applies on all subsequent renewals too. Not applicable to cataract, LASIK, OPD, maternity, daily cash, convalescence, accompanying person, accidental death, home health care, GRS, screening & vaccinations.

sub_limits.display: Cataract 20% of SI (max ₹1L/eye); Modern treatments 50% SI (max ₹5L); Bariatric 50% SI (max ₹5L); GRS ₹1L lifetime; Screening ₹20K/period
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at 20% of SI subject to max ₹1 lakh per eye. Modern treatments (robotic, etc.) capped at 50% of SI up to ₹5L. Bariatric surgery 50% SI up to ₹5L. LASIK sub-limited per schedule. Gender reassignment ₹1L lifetime. Screening & vaccinations ₹20K per policy period.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan. Voluntary deductible (₹10K–₹1L depending on plan) available as optional add-on on aggregate basis.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Fresh policies: 1 or 2 or 3 year PED waiting period options available per schedule. For portability/migration policies only 2-year option available. Best achievable for fresh policy is 12 months via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Most named ailments (cataract, hernia, hydrocele, etc.) have 12 or 24 month waiting period options. Joint replacement due to degenerative condition and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis have 36-month waiting. Best achievable is 12 months.

maternity.note: Maternity is an optional cover. Female insured + spouse must be covered continuously for 36 months before benefit activates. Sub-limits: Normal ₹20K–₹75K, Caesarean ₹30K–₹1L depending on plan chosen. Portability/migration not applicable.

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases 25% per claim-free year up to 100% of SI. Reduces at same rate if claim made. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster add-on gives additional 100%/yr up to 500% of SI.

restoration.note: Restoration of 100% base SI (excluding CB) triggered automatically for second claim in same policy year, whether same or new illness. Once per policy year; not carried forward. Chemotherapy/dialysis restoration usable once in lifetime per insured.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation cover days vary by plan: Mini plan 30/60/90 days options; Medi and Max plans 60/90/120 days options as per schedule.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation cover days vary by plan: Mini 60/90/120 days; Medi/Max 90/120 days options as per schedule.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 530 day-care procedures in Annexure I covered. Also covers any other surgeries/procedures requiring <24hr hospitalisation due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.display: Not covered (base); Home Health Care optional add-on
domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is specifically excluded under clause 4.2.3. However, Home Health Care (optional cover 3.2.11) covers up to 20% of SI for home treatment via empanelled providers on cashless basis.

ayush.note: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) hospitalisation is an optional cover (3.2.7) covered up to Sum Insured. Preventive/rejuvenation and OPD AYUSH excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to Sum Insured as inbuilt benefit, subject to organ being for insured person and compliance with Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance is an optional cover (3.2.9). Limit per hospitalisation varies: Mini ₹1K–₹2K, Medi ₹1.5K–₹3K, Max ₹2K–₹5K. Emergency Air Ambulance also optional: ₹1L–₹5L per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment procedures (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered as inbuilt but capped at 50% of SI up to ₹5L per policy year.

consumables.display: Optional add-on; up to 15% of admissible claim
consumables.note: Non-medical and consumable expenses (List I items) covered as optional add-on (3.2.12) up to 15% of admissible claim amount. Pre/post hospitalisation excluded from this cover.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly restricted to India only (clause 5.2.5). Treatment outside India excluded (clause 4.2.4).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 45 days before renewal. Bariatric surgery and maternity benefits are not portable.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, treatment outside India, STDs (non-HIV), external congenital anomaly, stem cell storage, hormone replacement therapy, OPD (base plan), dental (unless injury-related hospitalisation)

optional_riders.display: Maternity, Road Ambulance, Air Ambulance, Daily Hospital Cash, Convalescence, Accompanying Person, Accidental Death, Critical Illness Booster, Accident Booster, Consumables Cover, Home Health Care, AYUSH, Cumulative Bonus Booster, Voluntary Co-pay, Voluntary Deductible
